description: This file defines API endpoints using FastAPI's APIRouter for guiding users and processing documents. It sets up two protected POST endpoints, one for guidance and one for document processing, utilizing dependency injection for user authentication and calling service functions to handle core logic.

methods.name: guide(req: GuidanceRequest, _: str = Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Handles AI-guidance requests, invokes generation service, returns GuidanceResponse.

methods.name: document_process(file: UploadFile = File(...), _: str = Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Handles document processing requests, invokes processing service, returns DocumentProcessingResponse.

ctags.name: document_process
ctags.pattern: /^async def document_process(file: UploadFile = File(...), _: str = Depends(get_current_user)):$/
